item.title: Continue Reading: Privacy Policy
item.description:
Privacy Policy — Continue reading

Effective: October 4, 2026

Continue reading (“Continue”, “the app”) is an e-book reader developed by Mohammad Movahedi. This policy explains what information the app handles and where it goes.

In short: the app does not collect any personal information. There are no accounts with us, no analytics, no advertising and no tracking. Your books and reading data stay on your device and on the servers you choose to connect to.

item.title: Piano-ish: a free, open-source piano trainer
item.description:
Piano-ish is a free and open-source piano learning app for anyone who wants a more focused way to practice with a digital piano.

Piano-ish turns Standard MIDI files into interactive practice sessions. Import a piece, connect a MIDI keyboard if you have one, and work through the music with falling notes, traditional staff notation, or a combination of both. Instead of supplying a fixed catalog, Piano-ish is built around your own music library.

item.title: Wallpaper Manager
item.description:
I’m excited to introduce Wallpaper Manager, a local-first desktop app for organizing and automatically rotating your wallpapers.

Instead of limiting you to one wallpaper provider, Wallpaper Manager lets you create collections from local folders, RSS and Atom feeds, and other sources. You can combine collections into custom pools, mark images as favorites, choose their playback order, and control how frequently your background changes.
